top_signals.headline: Bank Indonesia Holds BI-Rate at 5.75% to Support Rupiah Stability
top_signals.impact: The central bank maintained its benchmark rate amid global uncertainty, balancing growth support with currency stability. Foreign reserves remain robust at $151.8B, providing FX intervention capacity.

top_signals.headline: JCI Index Resilient Above 7,200 as Foreign Flows Turn Positive
top_signals.impact: Jakarta Composite Index maintains strength driven by banking and consumer sectors. Net foreign buying resumed as EM sentiment improves on Fed pivot expectations. YTD performance +2.3%.

top_signals.headline: Indonesia Q3 GDP Grows 5.12% YoY, Beats Consensus Estimates
top_signals.impact: Economic expansion driven by household consumption (+4.9%) and fixed investment (+5.1%). Manufacturing PMI at 52.3 signals continued expansion. Full-year growth projected at 5.05-5.15%.

top_signals.headline: Federal Reserve Signals Potential December Rate Cut Amid Cooling Inflation
top_signals.impact: FOMC minutes suggest committee members see conditions for further easing. Core PCE trending toward 2.5% target. Markets pricing 65% probability of 25bp cut in December.

top_signals.headline: Indonesian Rupiah Stabilizes at 15,850/USD on Trade Surplus
top_signals.impact: Currency finds support from continued trade surplus ($10.5B Q3) and BI intervention. Carry trade dynamics remain favorable vs USD. Key resistance at 16,000 level.

top_signals.headline: Indonesian Banks Report Strong NIM Expansion in Q3 Results
top_signals.impact: Major banks (BBCA, BBRI, BMRI) posted 12-15% earnings growth with NIMs expanding to 5.2-5.8%. Loan growth accelerated to 11.5% YoY. NPL ratios stable at 2.1-2.4%.

top_signals.headline: S&P 500 Approaches All-Time High on AI Optimism and Rate Cut Bets
top_signals.impact: Index trading near 6,000 level as tech sector leads. Magnificent 7 stocks contribute 60% of YTD gains. Earnings growth re-accelerating to +8% YoY in Q4.

top_signals.headline: US 10-Year Treasury Yield Falls to 4.35% on Dovish Fed Outlook
top_signals.impact: Bond yields decline as markets reprice Fed trajectory. Real yields at +2.0% remain attractive for fixed income allocations. Duration positioning shifts to neutral.

top_signals.headline: S&P 500 books back-to-back losses as tech sells off, Bank of America slides after earnings: Live updates
top_signals.impact: The three major averages fell for a second consecutive session.

top_signals.headline: China Manufacturing PMI Expands to 51.5, Supporting EM Sentiment
top_signals.impact: Factory activity strengthens on stimulus measures and export recovery. Positive read-through for Asian supply chains and commodity demand. EM currencies rally.

top_signals.headline: Brent Crude Holds at $78/bbl as OPEC+ Maintains Production Discipline
top_signals.impact: Oil prices stabilize on balanced supply-demand outlook. OPEC+ compliance remains high at 95%. Inventory levels normalize. Range-bound trading expected near term.

top_signals.headline: Goldman Sachs tops profit estimates as equities, asset and wealth management outperform
top_signals.impact: Goldman's revenue dipped 3% in Q4, which the company said was the result of off-loading the Apple Card loan portfolio to JPMorgan Chase.

top_signals.headline: TSMC Ends 2025 With a Bang as AI Keeps Boosting Profits
top_signals.impact: World’s largest contract chip maker is caught in the middle of a long-awaited trade deal between Taiwan and the U.S.

top_signals.headline: Trump's proposed ban on buying single-family homes introduces uncertainty for family offices
top_signals.impact: Wall Street landlords are the primary target of Trump's proposed ban, but investment firms of the ultra rich could get caught in the crosshairs.

top_signals.headline: Coinbase CEO says key crypto vote can be rescheduled after 11th hour cancellation
top_signals.impact: Major crypto bill flounders as crypto, banks remain at odds over who can offer consumers rewards.

top_signals.headline: Amazon threatens 'drastic' action after Saks bankruptcy, says $475M stake is now worthless
top_signals.impact: Amazon invested $475 million into Saks' acquisition of Neiman Marcus. It wants a federal judge to reject Saks' bankruptcy plan because it harms creditors.

top_signals.headline: These charts show the stock market giving investors a lot to like — for now — as the S&P 500 nears 7,000
top_signals.impact: More stocks are making new 52-week highs and volatility is low.

top_signals.headline: Trump pitches direct payments to consumers for health care. What policy experts say about the plan
top_signals.impact: President Donald Trump wants to send payments directly to households for health costs. Experts think the plan may raise costs and the number of uninsured.

top_signals.headline: Why portfolio managers are whispering about inflation worries in 2026
top_signals.impact: A mix of soaring metals prices, geopolitical risks and threats to the Federal Reserve’s independence is raising the possibility that inflation may push higher than expected in 2026, upsetting traders’ expectations for stable to lower prices.

top_signals.headline: The S&P 500’s final push to 7,000 could be tougher than it looks
top_signals.impact: Wall Street is inching toward a historic milestone just as the ride is getting bumpier in the stock market.

top_signals.headline: This mix of stocks and bonds delivered double-digit gains last year — yet too many investors dismiss it
top_signals.impact: Why we should sing the praises of the tried-and-true 60/40 stocks-bonds portfolio.

top_signals.headline: College students and teens could be fueling the prediction markets boom
top_signals.impact: Where sports betting is legal, it's often limited to those 21 years or older. Kalshi and Polymarket are open to anyone 18 or older, with some exceptions.

top_signals.headline: Trump unveils health-care plan outline as Congress wrestles over Obamacare subsidies
top_signals.impact: Trump urged Congress, which is grappling over an extension of key ACA tax credits, to pass "The Great Healthcare Plan" without delay.
